name: Milk Cake
steps: Grease a small deep metal tin with a little measured ghee. Mix lemon juice with the water. Use a wide heavy pan so milk can reduce without scorching.
Bring milk to a boil, then simmer for 35–45 minutes, stirring and scraping the base and sides, until roughly half remains. Keep returning the soft milk solids to the pan.
Add diluted lemon gradually while stirring until small grains form in the thick milk. Stop adding once grainy; do not separate it into dry curds and clear whey.
Add sugar and cook over low heat for 20–30 minutes, stirring constantly as it thickens. Add the remaining ghee gradually; the mixture should become beige, grainy and pull away from the pan.
Mix in cardamom and pack firmly into the greased tin; scatter chopped pistachio on top. Cover loosely and cool for 45 minutes, then refrigerate until firm for at least 2 hours.
Unmould with a thin knife and cut into small pieces. The texture should be moist and granular, with a deeper colour possible in the centre; keep leftovers refrigerated.
passiveTime: Cool for 45 minutes, then chill for at least 2 hours.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
